transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you lately?

Well... I suppose my wife wanted me to come in. She says it's just regular talk, but... I don't know. 

The men down at the domino table... they've been slipping in these little messages. Just meant for me. Sometimes the fella on the radio does it, too. My wife tells me it's nothing, but... I know they're warning me to be careful. That's really all it is.
Do you believe that people are sending you special messages or trying to communicate with you in secret ways?

Well... like I just told you. I don't know about secret ways, but... they drop little hints. The fellas playing dominoes, or the man on the radio. 

Just telling me to watch my step. My wife don't hear it, but... I know what they mean. I don't really want to make a big fuss out of it.
Do you feel that these messages are part of a larger pattern where people are trying to harm you or plot against you?

I don't know about any plots. I'm... well, I'm just an old man. 

Like I said before, they're just... warning me. Giving me those little messages to be careful. I don't know what of, exactly, but... my wife thinks it's just regular talk. But I know a warning when I hear it. That's really all there is to it.
Do you feel like these messages are directed at you specifically, even when others don't seem to notice them?

Well... yes. Like I said. It's... it's just for me. My wife, she's sitting right there, but she don't hear it the same way. She just thinks it's regular talk. But the men at the table... the fellow on the radio... they're talking to me. Telling me to be careful. I don't know why nobody else catches it, but... I know what I hear.
Do you ever feel like things people say or do in everyday life, like something on TV or something someone says in passing, are specially meant for you, even if they don’t realize it?

Well... like I've been saying, doctor. That's... that's why I'm here. 

It's the men at the domino table, mostly. And the radio. It's just... they slip these little messages in. My wife, she tells me it's just regular talk, but... I know a warning when I hear one. They're telling me to be careful. That's all I know.
Do you ever feel that events happening around you, like something on TV or things people say in general, are specially meant for you, even if they don’t realize it?

I... I thought I just answered that, doctor. That's... that's the whole reason I came in. 

Like I said, it's the men at the domino table. And sometimes the announcer on the radio. They give me those little messages, and... well, they're meant for me. My wife keeps saying it's just regular talk, but... I know they're warning me to be careful. 

I don't really have anything else to tell you about it. That's just what happens.

Have you ever felt that things unrelated to the domino table or the radio—like something you saw on TV, a stranger’s comment, or something written in a newspaper—were also directed at you or meant something special for you?
No... no, I don't think so. Just what I told you already. The table and the radio. That's... that's all.
Have you ever felt that people are watching you, following you, or involved in some kind of plan related to you outside of the domino table or the radio?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. Just... just what I said before. Nobody's following me around.
Have you ever believed something strongly that others around you don’t believe, even though there’s no proof to support it?

I... doctor, we just went over this. It's exactly what I keep telling you. 

My wife, she's the one who doesn't believe it. She says I don't have proof, that it's just regular talk. But I know what I hear. Those men playing dominoes, the radio... they're sending those little messages to warn me to be careful. I know they are. 

I don't... I don't have anything else to add to that.
